Maya (sales): Hey team, Adam from FinServCo just asked for SOC 2 + ISO snippets and a signed pen-test letter for a POC that needs to run in their data center (on‑prem). Also asked: will dedicated/reserved pricing change if we require on‑prem/private?
Ben (solutions): Hi Maya — we can support Private but onboarding timeline and costs differ. Need to confirm: 1) do they want our Private control plane or fully air-gapped on‑prem? 2) expected throughput (qps/tokens) for the POC?
Adam (finservco): We need fully air-gapped on‑prem package for the pilot. Throughput small: ~5 concurrent sessions, 1k tokens/session peak. Main ask is compliance evidence + pen test attestation to satisfy our InfoSec.
Rosa (security): For pen-test letter: security@redwood can provide an attestation letter that we accepted the pen test and scope. We cannot sign a third‑party's NDA bundle without legal review. If they need a vendor-signed letter, Arjun can sign the standard template.
Arjun (legal): I can sign, but need the customer's template. Also note: our pen-test attestation references our SOC 2 report — we can provide a redacted SOC 2 bridge letter and an ISO-27001 control mapping excerpt, not full raw evidence.
Maya (sales): Adam — can you share FinServCo's pen-test letter template and the specific controls they need from ISO/SOC? Also, do you have a secure upload location for artifacts (SFTP or presigned)?
Adam (finservco): We'll upload to a presigned S3 link. Template attached. Controls list pinned below: encryption at rest, KMS separation, network isolation, change management, incident logging.
Lina (devops): For on‑prem: we need a network diagram and firewall IP allowlist to provide to your infra team. Private deployment will require a setup fee + 3‑month minimum for reserved capacity if you want predictable latency — that changes pricing.
Ben (solutions): Quick numbers: Private (VPC/on‑prem) has a platform fee + per-node hourly rate. Small POC (5 sessions) likely falls under our minimal footprint but still needs a 1‑month staging environment + 2 weeks for installation. I'll follow up with exact SKU.
Rosa (security): Artifact plan: we can deliver: - redacted SOC 2 report summary (PDF) - SOC 2 bridge letter (PDF) - ISO control mapping CSV - signed pen test attestation letter (PDF)
Rosa (security): Two caveats: 1) full test reports that include findings may be restricted if they contain customer data or third‑party details. 2) KMS separation for Private requires key-handling config; customers managing keys in an HSM will add ops work and a small infra surcharge.
Maya (sales): Adam — if you can upload the pen-test template to the presigned link, Arjun + Rosa will review and we can return a signed letter within 3 business days for a standard template. If there's custom legal redlines, expect 7–10 business days.
Adam (finservco): Uploaded: presigned link https://s3-presigned.example.com/finservco/poc-evidence.zip (exp 48h). Template in the zip. We'll also need a short statement about deployment timeline for procurement.
Ben (solutions): Received. I'll prepare a concise onboarding timeline: 2 weeks provisioning (onsite coordination), 1 week validation, total 3 weeks to go‑live for the POC. Note: Dedicated/reserved pricing impact: +platform fee $X/month + one-time install fee $Y. I'll DM finance for exact numbers and paste here.
audit-bot: New artifact request logged: ticket #SR-2026 — SOC2 excerpts + pen-test attestation. SLA: 5 business days.
Arjun (legal): Reviewed template. No major issues. Will sign the standard attestation. If they require vendor liability language changes, flag to me.
Rosa (security): To do: 1) Prepare redacted SOC2 PDF (mask customer-specific AR details) 2) Produce ISO control mapping (CSV) 3) Draft pen-test attestation to match template 4) Outline KMS options for on‑prem
Maya (sales): Great — Adam, once we return signed letter + SOC2 excerpts, will procurement accept a PO for the platform fee + staging fee?
Adam (finservco): Yes, procurement wants a short quote. Please include line items: platform fee, install fee, monthly reserved capacity.
Ben (solutions): Putting numbers here (estimate): platform fee: "$3,500" one-time install: "$1,200" monthly reserved: "$2,000" (for minimal 1 node). Finance to confirm.
Lina (devops): For the install, we'll need a contact on FinServCo side for VPN and an SSH bastion user. Send me a time window for on‑prem engineers.
Maya (sales): Thanks all. Action items: Ben/Finance — confirm pricing by EOD. Rosa/Arjun — sign and upload attestation within 3 business days. Lina — coordinate install window after pricing. Adam — confirm procurement timeline. :thumbsup:
Adam (finservco): Procurement timeline: PO in 10 business days once we have signed attestation + quote. Thanks!
Ben (solutions): FYI finance confirmed the numbers, pulling formal quote now.
Rosa (security): Uploads ready, preparing redacted SOC2 and pen-test attestation. Will upload to the presigned link when done.
Maya (sales): Closing loop — will post final quote + signed attestation here when available.
